title: The /review-code command sends Codex reviewers on Windows to a shell that fails
outcome: The /review-code command sends Codex reviewers on Windows to a shell that fails
acceptance: .claude/commands/review-code.md tells a Codex reviewer to run its read-only Git commands in its default exec_command shell, and keeps the Bash-tool wording only for Claude reviewers
A Codex /review-code reviewer spawned on this Windows host runs git status --short and git diff --cached successfully without a brief that overrides the shell

completion.summary:
Landed in 7424da9.
- /review-code tells a Claude reviewer to use the Bash tool and a Codex reviewer to use its default exec_command shell, never "bash" or a Git Bash path, which resolve to a missing WSL on this host.
- Lens discovery uses Glob or `rg --files .claude/reviewers -g '*.md'` instead of Unix find, and the helper bullet gives Codex Get-Content or rg.
- Four Codex reviewers (sessions 7825, 7827, 7829, 7831) ran git status --short and git diff --cached in PowerShell with no shell advice in their brief.
- Independent Codex evaluation: 2/2 pass.
